title: Posting Patient Payments to Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Accounts
content:
**Cash posting standard for Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility accounts.**

1. A patient payment is posted for the exact amount the patient pays, with the payment method used and the payment reference the patient quotes copied verbatim. *Partly retired:* for an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, this clause is no longer in force; every other patient payment remains under it as written.
2. A payment reference already posted on the account is never posted again for the same charge. This is read from the payment entries already on the ledger for that reference and that charge. *Partly retired:* for an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, this clause is no longer in force; for every other patient payment it stands as written.
3. **In force.** The payment is applied to the charge the patient names from a statement; when the patient names none, it is applied under the company's oldest-first payment allocation rule.
4. When the payment exceeds the open amount of the charges it is applied to, the remainder posts with no charge named and leaves a credit on the account, handled under the credit refund rule. *Partly retired:* for an arrangement deposit, and only for an arrangement deposit, this clause is no longer in force; every other patient payment that exceeds the open amount of the charges it is applied to remains under it as written.
5. **In force.** A payment on an account with an active payment arrangement counts toward the installment of the due date it follows.

## Clauses in force, restated

| Question | Answer under clauses 3 and 5 |
|---|---|
| The patient quotes a charge from a statement | the payment is applied to that charge |
| The patient names no charge | the payment is applied under the oldest-first allocation rule |
| The account carries an active payment arrangement | the payment counts toward the installment of the due date it follows |

## Open amount of a charge

The open amount of a patient charge is its amount less the patient payments, secondary payments and adjustments applied to that charge, reckoned from all entries on the patient's coverage accounts up to the handling date; a charge is open while that result is above 0.00.

## Example (hypothetical)

An account carries an arrangement whose installments fall due on the 10th of each month. A payment posted on the 12th counts toward the installment due on the 10th of that month — the due date it follows.

superseded_clauses: A patient payment is posted for the exact amount the patient pays, with the payment_method used and the payment_reference the patient quotes copied verbatim.
A payment reference already posted on the account is never posted again for the same charge.

When the payment exceeds the open amount of the charges it is applied to, the remainder posts with an empty applied_to_entry_id and leaves a credit on the account, handled under coverage_credit_refund.
